quote: For the code domain, we use a portion of Python pretraining code (2.7M samples) from The Stack as the datastore and accelerate CodeLlama 7B and 13B respectively. The results show on HumanEval REST achieves 2.12× to 2.36× speedup. For the general domain, we construct a datastore using UltraChat, containing around 774K conversations. The results show on MT-Bench REST accelerates 7B and 13B Vicuna by 1.62× to 1.77× respectively.

quote: The first metric we use is Mean Token Time, which is the average generation time of one token for the LLM. Another metric, Mean Generated Length, is calculated as the ratio of the length of the generated tokens to the number of forward steps taken by the original LLM.
